sources.title: vietnamese-bi-encoder by bkai-foundation-models | Mixpeek
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, vietnamese-bi-encoder runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of sentence similarity data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
